exposure: Pharmacist-led antibiotic stewardship interventions (development of a protocol, educational meeting, audit and feedback)
outcome: Compliance with timing of surgical antibiotic prophylaxis
Compliance with duration of surgical antibiotic prophylaxis
cohort: The study included 226 and 238 surgical procedures in obstetrics and gynecology during pre- and post-intervention periods, respectively, performed in two tertiary hospitals.
finding: Antibiotic stewardship interventions significantly improved compliance with timing and duration of surgical antibiotic prophylaxis, reduced antibiotic utilization and cost, without a significant difference in surgical site infection rate.
